analysis.headline: No Data Selling/Marketing Shares
analysis.quote: We will not: sell or rent your data to third parties share your data with third parties for marketing purposes

analysis.headline: Shares With Other Government Depts
analysis.quote: The data we collect may be shared with other government departments, agencies and organisations.

analysis.headline: Shares With Tech Suppliers
analysis.quote: It may also be shared with our technology suppliers, for example our hosting provider.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Email Usage
analysis.quote: how you use our emails - for example whether you open them and which links you click on

analysis.headline: Google Analytics Tracks You
analysis.quote: Where you provide your consent, we use Google Analytics cookies and a Real User Monitoring ( RUM ) cookie from SpeedCurve to collect information about how you use GOV.UK.

analysis.headline: Your Data Processed Outside EEA
analysis.quote: Data collected by Google Analytics and SpeedCurve RUM may be transferred outside the EEA for processing.

analysis.headline: Feedback Data Kept 2 Years
analysis.quote: keep your feedback data for 2 years

analysis.headline: Not Intended For Children
analysis.quote: Our services are not designed for, or intentionally targeted at, children 13 years of age or younger. We do not intentionally collect or maintain data about anyone under the age of 13.
